items.sentence: In fact, this activity *is* often the highlight of a visitor's vacation, and these rides *bring* a lot of money into the Thai economy.

items.sentence: However, there *is* a dark side to elephant tourism that would horrify many travelers.
items.pattern: There + Vi + S + Relative clause (that...)

items.sentence: Due to high demand in Thailand's tourism industry, some young wild elephants *are illegally captured and sold* to tourist attractions.
items.pattern: Prepositional phrase + S + Passive compound verb phrase + Prepositional phrase

items.sentence: These young elephants *are lured* away from their mothers and into traps.

items.pattern: S + Vi + Prepositional phrase + Participial phrase + and + It + Vl + C + Infinitival phrase

items.pattern: Adverbial clause (Once...) + S + Vi + Adverbial clause (as...)

items.sentence: Confined in small cages, these poor creatures *are beaten* mercilessly for days and even *struck* with sharp nails.
items.pattern: Participial phrase + S + Passive compound verb phrase + Prepositional phrases

items.pattern: Compound S + Relative clause (of which...) + Passive verb phrase + Infinitival phrase

items.pattern: S + Passive verb phrase + Infinitival phrase + Prepositional phrases

text_genre.raw_text:
Passage Structure Analysis
Introduction / Problem Setup (Para 1): Highlights Thailand’s lucrative elephant tourism industry and introduces the thesis—there is a horrific dark side behind this popular activity.
Cause / Dark Reality 1: Poaching & Cruel Taming (Para 2): Details how young elephants are illegally captured (often leading to their mothers being killed) and violently abused in cages to break their spirit and make them obedient.
Cause / Dark Reality 2: Exploitation & Abuse in Slavery (Para 3): Explains the physical toll on tamed elephants—spine injuries from carrying heavy loads, starvation, and continuous beatings with bullhooks driven by tourist demand.
Solution / Call to Action (Para 4): Emphasizes that tourist demand fuels this cruelty and urges travelers to boycott elephant rides, offering ethical alternatives like visiting national parks instead.
